description: Live /v1/chat answer for a multi-stop trip turn, captured as the quality target for itinerary answers. request.message: im doing hanoi, then hue, then hoi an — what should i stop at along the way?

seed.claims: 5 place claims + 4 area claims (curated_expert), see ADR-148 verification

response.message:
you've got a solid line already saved across the route. here's how i'd play it:

[hanoi](kebi://area/vn/hanoi)

start with [Railway Tuan](kebi://venue/939ba8f5-e83b-4e64-9d3b-b1eeb00b096b) Cafe in the old quarter. it's cozy and morning light is the move there, you've got a long drive south after, so hit it early before the heat. the 7pm train is the one worth waiting for if you're sticking around longer, but for a pass-through, coffee and the vibe is enough.

hue

[Quán Hạnh](kebi://venue/a3c3ca18-4041-4188-ad8d-9cf52df669bb) is your stop here, traditional banh loc and it's cash only. go before 6, the banh loc runs out early evening and that's the whole reason to be there. it's a dinner move, not lunch.

the leg between hue and hoi an

not on your list but it's on your way, [Bếp](kebi://venue/a853b835-5e9a-4169-a9ad-c4aa1c4175f4) Hiền sits on the drive and you've got places saved there already. closes between services around 2 to 5pm, so plan lunch or dinner around that gap. if you're riding the motorbike route, [Motorvina Da Nang](kebi://venue/4892f6da-ab37-4df0-b4a7-a2b7e244ca98) is on the way between the cities and does one-way scooter rentals if you want to tackle the Hai Van Pass properly.

hoi an

[Roving Chill house](kebi://venue/743de441-cdee-4166-80a5-576215e31bcc) is the one from your saves, and it's the right move here, go before 10 in the morning when the rice paddy light is good and the tour groups haven't landed yet. then [Nữ Eatery](kebi://venue/1965297d-4ab1-49a9-9084-723c9909d2ce) for a casual lunch or brunch vibe on the same street.

how many nights are you spending in each city? that changes what else is worth your time once you've eaten.
